title: FAMPWQ: Fisher Information-based Adaptive Mixed Precision Weight Quantization for Effective LLM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2608.24945v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent years have witnessed remarkable achievements of Large Language Models (LLMs) in multiple domains, while the excessive resource requirements of LLMs hinder the deployment on resource-constrained devices. Although model quantization stands out as an effective approach, conventional quantization approaches typically incur severe performance degradation due to uniform bit-width or simple heuristic sensitivity evaluation. In this paper, we propose a novel Fisher information-based Adaptive Mixed Precision Weight Quantization approach, i.e., FAMPWQ, which performs layer-adaptive weight quantization for effective LLM inference on commodity GPUs. First, we propose a system model with a novel Fisher information metric to measure the layer-wise sensitivity to quantization. Second, we propose a reinforcement learning-based bit-width allocator in FAMPWQ, which generates an adaptive bit-width allocation strategy based on the Fisher information

translated_title: 基于Fisher信息的自适应混合精度权重量化方法FAMPWQ，用于高效的大语言模型推理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24945v1 公告类型：新 摘要：近年来，大型语言模型（LLMs）在多个领域取得了显著成就，但其过高的资源需求阻碍了在资源受限设备上的部署。尽管模型量化是一种有效的方法，但传统量化方法通常因统一位宽或简单的启发式敏感性评估而导致严重的性能下降。本文提出了一种新颖的基于Fisher信息的自适应混合精度权重量化方法，即FAMPWQ，该方法在商用GPU上进行层自适应权重量化，以实现高效的LLM推理。首先，我们提出一个系统模型，采用新颖的Fisher信息度量来衡量每层对量化的敏感性。其次，我们在FAMPWQ中提出一个基于强化学习的位宽分配器，该分配器根据Fisher信息生成自适应位宽分配策略。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Fisher信息和强化学习的自适应混合精度权重量化方法，通过层敏感度度量与动态位宽分配，在商用GPU上实现高效且低损耗的LLM推理。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an adaptive mixed-precision weight quantization method based on Fisher information and reinforcement learning, which achieves efficient and low-loss LLM inference on commodity GPUs via layer-wise sensitivity measurement and dynamic bit-width allocation.
